name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 06, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-e, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular Meetings of January 16, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Teri Black & Company, LLC to conduct the Public Works Director recruitment
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Teri Black & Company, LLC to conduct the Public Works Director recruitment in an amount not to exceed $27,500.
Item #7d
e.
Consideration of a new Class Specification and Salary Schedule assignment for Deputy City Clerk/Executive Assistant
RES 2018-06 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending Resolution No. 2017-28, a resolution establishing a compensation plan for employees for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2017 and ending June 30, 2018.
ACTION: Approve the class specification for Deputy City Clerk/Executive Assistant; and adopt a resolution amending the compensation plan for employee for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2017 and ending June 30, 2018, to assign Salary Schedule No. 70 to the Deputy City Clerk/Executive Assistant classification.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE ADDING CHAPTER 7.5 (UNCLAIMED PROPERTY) TO TITLE II (ADMINISTRATION) OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE ORD NO. 795 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, adding Chapter 7.5 (Unclaimed Property) to Title II (Administration) of the Lomita Municipal Code to dispose of unclaimed property within the jurisdiction of the City of Lomita. First Reading
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council after the City Attorney reads the title:
1)
Introduce first reading of an Ordinance adding Chapter 7.5 (Unclaimed Property) to Title II (Administration) of the Lomita Municipal Code to regulate Disposition of Unclaimed Property within the jurisdiction of the City of Lomita; and
2)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the February 20, 2018 City Council meeting.
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 20, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
